plan.title: Bulk Counter Offer Disabled on Live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses screen with one vendor bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Ensure RFQ counter offers are not hidden.
Enable buyer bid editing as required.
Enable percentage counter offers as required.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu containing Send Bulk Counter Offer.
Assert that Send Bulk Counter Offer is greyed out and that its explanation tooltip is present.
